title: If You Loved Parasite, Watch These
intro: Class warfare, hidden rot beneath polished surfaces, and that moment the floor gives way. These films leave a mark.

films.title: Burning
films.line: A slow-burning mystery about class envy and a disappearance that haunts you long after.

films.title: A Tale of Two Sisters
films.line: A homecoming unravels into something gorgeous and deeply, deeply wrong.

films.title: Shoplifters
films.line: A makeshift family held together by secrets and a tenderness that quietly breaks your heart.

films.title: mother!
films.line: A house, a marriage, and a spiral into chaos that demands you sit with its fury.

films.title: The Handmaiden
films.line: A con artist plot twists itself inside out with style, desire, and breathtaking betrayal.

films.title: Caché
films.line: Surveillance tapes appear at a family's door and guilt starts eating the walls from inside.

films.title: Memories of Murder
films.line: Two detectives spiral into obsession chasing a killer who always seems one step ahead.

films.title: Oldboy
films.line: Fifteen years locked in a room and the answer, when it comes, will wreck you completely.

films.title: Mother
films.line: A mother will cross every line to protect her son and you will question every step she takes.

films.title: Knives Out
films.line: The moment you think you understand the game, someone flips the entire board.

films.title: Get Out
films.line: Politeness has never felt so suffocating, or so perfectly designed to trap you.
